title: Site record (v0.2 MVP subset)
description: Knowledge that applies to every page on one domain. MVP fields only: site, schema, access, provenance.

site.description: Normalized host, lowercase, no scheme or path, e.g. docs.stripe.com

access.description: How to get content from this site. Omit fields you did not observe.

js_required.description: true if a plain fetch returns an empty shell and the page must be rendered

blocks_headless.description: true if headless browsers are blocked or served a challenge page

md_versions.description: How to get Markdown versions of pages, e.g. 'append .md to any docs URL'

api.description: Public API endpoint pattern that returns the same data, e.g. 'GET https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/{name}'

api_notes.description: Which fields of the API response matter and how large it is

extraction_issues.description: Known problems turning pages into text, and the workaround

observed_at.description: ISO date the site was checked
